description: What is trending on Arc right now: tokens ranked by NET USDC inflow (buys minus sells) over the last hour and 24 h, from every Uniswap v4 pool, with volume, buys and sells, price change and pool age. Only tokens our live sell test can sell right now are listed (launch-and-pull pools are counted as excluded). Ranked by inflow, not volume, so two-way wallet farms do not top it. No input. Facts, never advice. $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: arc_trending
